Flow 6, the auth pages. Locked 19 Aug 2026.

Same header as the guided line: the wordmark (a link back to the site) and one quiet text link top right. One card, one serif heading, Google first, one gold button, one line under the card for the other path. Browser titles: 'Log in · Useful Apply', 'Sign up · Useful Apply', 'Reset password · Useful Apply'. /login and /signup resolve. First-timers normally never see A2: they sign up inside the guided line at step 4a; A2 is for links from the site and from email.

A1 Log in: Google, email, password (show/hide), 'Forgot password?' aligned right, gold 'Log in'. Header right: 'New here? Try it free' (to the guided line). Under the card: 'Don't have an account? Sign up'.
A2 Sign up: 'Create your free account · 4 credits a month, no card.' Google, name, email, password, gold 'Create account', terms line. Header right: 'Log in'.
A3 Reset: one field, gold 'Send the link', 'It works for 30 minutes.' Under the card: 'Back to log in'.
A4 Check your email: used after a reset request and after sign-up verification. Says the address, what to do, and 'send it again' after a minute. Under the card: 'Wrong address? Start over'.
